observations: Photo 0 shows a beige/cream upholstered sofa/bench seat with tufted/stitched detailing and a curved armrest/backrest shape.
The upholstery looks intact in the visible areas (no obvious tears), but the photo angle limits inspection of underside, back, and seams.
A watermark text is visible on the image, but no clear brand/model label is readable.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of age/usage history (no receipts, tags, or wear indicators clearly attributable to 3 months).
Photo 0 provides no measurement reference; length cannot be confirmed from the image alone.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear (stains, sagging cushions, seam splits) not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of all seams, the underside/legs, and both sides/back; plus a short video showing the cushion bounce and any creaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used sofa with possible wear (not guaranteed like-new).

risks.risk: Upholstery quality issues (fading, odor, water damage) that may not show in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the fabric under bright light and a quick smell/odor check confirmation; request a cleaning history statement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as-is with no guarantee of freshness/odor-free condition.

risks.risk: Size/fit mismatch ("over 4 feet" may be inaccurate).
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo showing length from end to end (and seat width).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the smaller end of the likely range for a sofa/bench.

risks.risk: Frame/structure problems (loose joints, broken internal frame) not detectable from a still image.
risks.proof: Request a video of someone sitting/standing weight on the sofa and a check of wobble/creaking.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if structure may need inspection/repair (worst-case for remote buying).

proof_requests: Tape-measure photo showing exact length (end-to-end) and seat width.
Close-up photos of: all seams, corners, underside/legs, and any buttons/tufting areas.
Short video: press/bounce test on cushions and a wobble/creak check on the frame.
Photos of the back and underside (where damage is often hidden).
response.reason: From photo 0, the item appears to be a used upholstered sofa/bench, but the key pricing drivers (exact size, cushion/frame condition, and hidden damage) are not verifiable from the single angle. Request measurements and condition proof before pricing.
